description:
The mermaid exporter declares a class for the retired `open` state, and none for three states its nodes use.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/visualization.rs:217-221` declares `classDef` lines including `open`. Nodes use the classes `backlog|ready|inprogress|gated|done|rejected|archived` (`:189-197`), so `backlog`, `gated` and `rejected` are undeclared and `open` is unused. `test_export_mermaid_format` (`visualization.rs:369-388`) asserts `classDef open`. `tests/cli_repo_workflow/integration_test.rs:255` asserts that a `classDef` exists. The dot exporter keeps its own per-state colour table (`visualization.rs:128-136`).

`State::all()` and `State::as_str()` exist (`domain/types.rs:71-101`). Mermaid accepts underscores, so `inprogress` becomes `in_progress`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The mermaid exporter declares exactly one `classDef` per lifecycle state, generated from the state enumeration, and no other class.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each node's class is its state's canonical token.
- [hard] REQ-03: One owning test proves that the declared class set equals the state enumeration and that every node class is declared.

## Notes

A state-to-style table may be shared with the dot exporter.
title: Derive mermaid state classes from the state enumeration
